The '''Shattered Ridge''' was a chain of [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. The [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] thought the melting of the [[Water/Legends|snow]] on the slopes of the Shattered Ridge foreshadowed a mythical event known as the [[Wild Hunt]].
